page.overview:
What is Westmarch?

The Westmarch was a region in western Eriador, that became part of The Shire in FO 31.

As the White Downs formed the former western borders of the Shire, the area further west was originally outside the Shire.

In SR 1452, King Elessar granted the Shire a stretch of new land as a gift: this reached from the White Downs to the Tower Hills, with the Far Downs in between. Thereafter, this district became known as the Westmarch, and the Shire's western boundaries were thus extended to the Tower Hills.

The eldest daughter of Mayor Samwise Gamgee, Elanor the Fair, married Fastred of Greenholm, with Greenholm itself being a Westmarch settlement located on the Far Downs. The spouses moved and settled in the town of Under-towers at the foot of the Tower Hills. After the passing of Master Samwise, they and their children became known as the Fairbairns of the Towers, and the Red Book of Frodo and Bilbo Baggins passed into their keeping, becoming known as the Red Book of Westmarch.
